fields.Name: T138 - Execution Monitor Filter and Drill to Action
fields.Description: Execution-list result-code/status filtering plus the cross-navigation from an execution row to its parent action record (openAction) — a drill-through path unique to the Monitor.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to the 'Actions' application, and open the 'Monitor' nav item. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away. In the toolbar, use the 'Search executions...' box or open the Filters popover (which can filter by result/status) and verify the Recent Executions list RESPONDS — rows narrow to matches or a clear 'No executions found' empty-state appears with a hint to adjust filters. If any execution rows are present, click an execution's action-name link and verify it navigates/opens that action's record (drill-through). The list responding to the filter (and, when data exists, the drill-through) is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Searching or filtering executions narrows the Recent Executions list OR shows a valid 'No executions found' empty-state
When executions exist, clicking an execution's action name navigates to / opens that action record
The results-count indicator reflects the filtered set
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
